summary: The diff implements the four main requirements (REQ-26 through REQ-30) with most features present. However, several specific acceptance criteria are not fully met: the admin principal constant is not a simple hardcoded value at the top of main.mo (it is delegated to an AccessControl module), the deleteFeedback implementation has a bug (uses removeLast instead of removing the matched entry), and several unrequested features were added including an AccessControl module, migration file, and extra hooks.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin principal constant must be defined at the top of the actor, initially set to '2vxsx-fae' with a comment instructing the deployer to replace it with their actual Internet Identity principal.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff uses an AccessControl module and MixinAuthorization mixin instead of a hardcoded admin principal constant at the top of the actor. There is no literal '2vxsx-fae' constant with a replacement comment visible in backend/main.mo.

missing_requirements.requirement: deleteFeedback removes the feedback entry with the matching id.
missing_requirements.reason: The implementation finds the matching index but then calls feedbackStore.removeLast() instead of removing the item at the found index. This means a non-last entry with the given id would not be correctly deleted.

hallucinated_features.description: AccessControl module and MixinAuthorization mixin for admin checking, plus _initializeAccessControlWithSecret and isCallerAdmin() backend functions, and a caffeineAdminToken URL parameter mechanism.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked for a single hardcoded admin principal constant with a simple equality check. The diff introduces a full AccessControl/authorization module system, secret token initialization, and an isCallerAdmin query — none of which were requested.

hallucinated_features.description: getCallerUserProfile(), saveCallerUserProfile(), and getUserProfile(user: Principal) backend functions.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked for registerUser, getMyProfile, getUsers, deleteUser, and deleteFeedback. These additional profile functions were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: backend/migration.mo file for migrating old feedback store format.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not ask for a migration module. It only asked to add an id field to stored feedback. A separate migration.mo file was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: useAllFeedbackAdmin hook in useQueries.ts for admin feedback fetching.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specified hooks: useMyProfile, useAllUsers, useRegisterUser, useDeleteUser, useDeleteFeedback. A separate useAllFeedbackAdmin hook was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: useIsCallerAdmin React Query hook that calls actor.isCallerAdmin().
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not request this hook. Admin status was to be determined by comparing the authenticated principal to the hardcoded constant on the frontend side.

hallucinated_features.description: frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts utility with URL parameter, sessionStorage persistence, and secret token extraction functions.
hallucinated_features.reason: This utility was not requested in any of the requirements. It appears added to support the hallucinated AccessControl token mechanism.
